{{Otheruses|Canister}}
'''Bacta canisters''' were portable one-use field kit manufactured by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]]. Containing [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] ointments and emergency medical tools, they can both heal wounds and restore vitality. It was recommended as an essential item for field medics.<ref name="JK2JO">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyle Katarn]] used these canisters during the [[Empire Reborn]] campaign<ref name="JK2JO" /> in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].
